structural_audit.exactness_argument: Each Montgomery call consumes canonical residues. Its int64 product and low-word product are bounded; the correction makes the numerator divisible by 2^16. Reduction is congruent to a*b/R modulo3329 and lies below2q, so one conditional subtraction is sufficient. Fused signed sums plus2q and final sums plusq are nonnegative and bounded before remainder. All steps are exact.
structural_audit.linearity_argument: Every gather index and coefficient depends only on width/stage/lane. Modular additions, subtractions, and multiplication by fixed field constants define a linear map over F_3329; conditional canonicalization changes representatives, not the field map. Complete basis agreement establishes the map for every canonical field-valued input row, not merely sparse inputs. The output is canonical, so field equality implies exact integer equality.
structural_audit.row_independence_argument: One program handles one row. All input/output relative addresses are row*N+lane (input lane bit-reversed), all gathers stay in0..N-1, all outputs have unique complete coverage. Nonzero base offsets do not alter these addresses. All256 supported batch/width address layouts are checked.
structural_audit.scope: Source modular arithmetic/address proof and finite operator verification, with separate compiled GPU basis/storage checks required. This does not prove every GPU execution or another compiler/environment.
